name: Brumal-Rift
description: A shell of ancient ice seals the world, cracked into plates the size of nations and refrozen in place. Pressure ridges stack in turquoise ramparts, gleaming under a stingy sun near a subterranean ocean.
Vacuum carries no sound at all; the loudest thing on this world is your own pulse inside the suit.
Established during the last boom, the pirate hideout was never decommissioned. Its roster lists eleven souls; life-support draws power for thirty.
The quarantine perimeter has held for years, mostly out of mutual disinterest. Everyone checks the fence anyway.
